question: Identify the synonym of 'Wistful':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Nostalgic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Wistful"** means having or showing a feeling of vague or regretful longing. (भावुक या उदासीन)
 
 
• **Example:** She gave him a wistful smile as she watched him leave.
 
 
• **"Nostalgic"** refers to a sentimental longing or wistful affection for the past, typically for a period or place with happy personal associations. (स्मृतिपूर्ण या पुरानी यादों से जुड़ा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example:** He felt nostalgic while looking at his childhood photos.
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Wistful"** is **"Nostalgic"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Nostalgic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Content** (संतुष्ट): A state of peaceful happiness or satisfaction.
 
 
• **Example:** She was content with her simple life.
 
 

 
• **Joyful** (आनंदित): Feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness.
 
 
• **Example:** The children were joyful during the Christmas party.
 
 

 
• **Happy** (खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.
 
 
• **Example:** She was happy to hear the good news.
